description: The lights of the lighthouse for the setting extra_lights. The room at the top of the lighthouse (cell RSU01FF) has the seal drawn into its floor (FLOOR4_I, texture RSULH3): a ring about 7 m across around the spiral stair at (60, -20) whose lines are the brightest texels of the map, a warm glow the original draws at every moment, so it shines all the time. Four low bulbs on the ring, each with a wide emitter, stand for the glowing disc: the floor, the stair, the railing and the poles take a soft warm light from below. The lamps of the pier and the streets give no light at night (glows: null): outdoors only the flashlight lights the dark. Positions are metres, PS1 axes (y down).
